subject: Retention exception request: Alderwell backup handoff & log carveout
messages:
From: Lisa Morton <lisa.morton@alderwell.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Hayes <mike_hayes@procurepartners.io>, Alderwell Legal <legal@alderwell.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Short-term retention: migration handoff and logs

Hi Sofia,

We kick off our data center migration on May 9 and we have a hard dependency on a 30-day snapshot window during the transition so our restore/dev teams can validate the migrated dataset. Our security team also flagged that several operational logs (API audit logs and job worker traces) are needed for post-migration reconciliation for 45 days.

Can Redwood temporarily extend the backup retention for Alderwell by 30 days for the snapshot lineage starting May 9 and provide a log-retention carveout until June 23? We realize this is an exception to the DPA terms; Alderwell Legal is prepared to sign a short DPA amendment that limits the exception to these specific snapshot IDs and the migration window.

Deliverables we need from Redwood:
- Confirmation of the snapshot IDs that will be kept and where copies will be stored (encrypted, KMS key id)
- A deletion-runbook describing how those snapshots/logs will be purged after the carveout window
- Evidence of any subprocessors that will touch the retained backups during the window

I attached a short operations note from our infra lead (see snapshot_manifest_Q2.csv) and flagged the critical snapshot IDs.

Thanks,
Lisa Morton
Head of Platform Ops, Alderwell Labs
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Morton <lisa.morton@alderwell.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term retention: migration handoff and logs

Hi Lisa — thanks for the context and the manifest. Appreciate Alderwell giving us precise IDs, that makes this feasible.

Quick notes / next steps from our side:
- We can provision a conditional retention exception scoped to the snapshot IDs in the attached CSV and mark them with an immutable tag so normal retention rules do not apply for the stated window.
- For operational logs, we can enable a temporary log-carveout and route those events to a restricted bucket with explicit ACLs and an encryption key you control (KMS).
- This will require a short DPA amendment + a subprocessors disclosure addendum (we must notify a storage subprocessor we use in the EU for cross-region buffering).

Irene/Marcus — can you chime in on the operational impact and confirm the purge mechanism? Tentative plan is: create the immutable snapshots on May 9, hold through June 8 (30 days) for snapshots, and keep logs until June 23 (45 days). After June 23 we run the documented deletion-runbook and emit an audit proof bundle.

Lisa — can Alderwell Legal sign the DPA amendment via DocuSign? If so we can link the DocuSign envelope in the next message and attach our redline. Also attaching our internal deletion-runbook draft for your review.

Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Morton <lisa.morton@alderwell.com>, Alderwell Legal <legal@alderwell.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term retention: migration handoff and logs

Folks — quick legal/compliance input:
- We can accept a scoped DPA amendment limited to the snapshot IDs and log buckets you specified. Need the amendment to include: explicit time window, retention scope, access controls (who at Redwood can decrypt), and data destruction verification artifacts.
- Subprocessor notification: we use CloudStoreInc for ephemeral cross-region buffering; per the DPA we must notify Alderwell and include their contact in the subprocessor addendum. If Alderwell objects to CloudStoreInc touching the retained snapshots, we need to know now (ideally by COB May 7) so we can route through our EU-free buffer.
- Please do not assume backups are editable while under immutable tag — operations will need to coordinate a short window to snapshot copies and then run purge flows; Marcus, flag any manual steps we need to record.

Lisa — I've prepared a redline of the amendment and attached dpa-amendment-redline.docx. We will send the DocuSign envelope once Alderwell confirms subprocessor acceptance.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Morton <lisa.morton@alderwell.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term retention: migration handoff and logs

Action summary and next steps — finalizing timeline: 
- Snapshot window: May 9 (create immutable snapshot lineage ids listed in snapshot_manifest_Q2.csv) -> retention until June 8 (30 days).
- Log carveout: route audit and job traces to restricted bucket, retention until June 23 (45 days).
- Post-window purge: Redwood runs deletion-runbook-v2.pdf, generates an audit proof bundle (deletion manifest + checksums + KMS key rotation evidence) within 72 hours of purge completion.
- Subprocessors: CloudStoreInc will be involved for transient buffering. Alderwell to confirm acceptance or request EU-free buffer by COB May 7.
- DPA amendment: Kimberly's redline attached. Lisa, please sign via DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123 once your team confirms the subprocessor note.

Attachments: deletion-runbook-v2.pdf, snapshot_manifest_Q2.csv, dpa-amendment-redline.docx

I'll run a short ops checklist on May 8 to validate snapshot creation and will send the retention tags to your infra point of contact.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
